description.value: Grand Chinese Restaurant – Yaletown is a sit-down Chinese restaurant in Vancouver's Yaletown neighbourhood offering an extensive menu of Northern Chinese, dim sum, and Korean-influenced dishes. The kitchen stands out for specialties like hand-folded Xinjiang cumin lamb dumplings, Shanghai xiao long bao, and Szechuan broth-braised beef that go well beyond a standard takeout menu. Its location one block from the False Creek Seawall puts it within easy reach of cyclists on one of Vancouver's most popular riding corridors.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and confirms the Yaletown location at 1233 Hamilton St, Vancouver, BC V6B6K3 with phone +1 604-681-8288, matching OSM exactly. Online pickup ordering is explicitly offered on the location page, and the menu lists numerous vegetarian items (Vegetable & Tofu Chow Mein, Steamed Veggie Dumplings, Vegetable Buns, etc.). No cyclist-specific amenities — bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi — are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags, leaving all three required criteria unconfirmed.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The restaurant is active and well-situated for cyclists on the False Creek Seawall, but none of the three required WWC criteria (bike parking/visibility, water refill, washrooms) are confirmed from the website or OSM tags; direct contact or a site visit is needed before listing.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu includes multiple vegetarian items: Vegetable & Tofu Chow Mein, Steamed Veggie Dumplings, Deep-Fried Veggie Dumplings, Vegetable Buns, Pan-Fried Chive Pockets, and Red Bean Pan Cake
